comparison.objective: Verify a gauge with a known-good reference before deciding whether to quarantine or retest a failed part.
comparison.physical_skill: Place a reference on a test pad, read a lamp, conditionally sort/tag, and restore the reference.
comparison.success_condition: Disposition must follow the check and match its result; two trials cover calibrated and drifted outcomes.
comparison.reason: Both use a physical test to guide action, but this is discrete diagnosis and conditional sorting rather than iterative mechanical tuning to quantitative motion and force limits.
